developer_description: The ultimate multiplayer racing experience with hundreds of cars.

reviews.text: Stuttering on RTX 3060, 40 fps at low settings. Unoptimized garbage.
Every car and track locked behind microtransactions. Pay-to-win in a racing game?
Handling feels great with a wheel, drifting is satisfying. If they fix performance it will be a 9/10.
Servers are dead, long matchmaking, empty lobbies. Online mode is unplayable.
Looks like a mobile port. Menus are awful and controller support is broken.
Cool cars and nice graphics, fun for the price of a coffee on sale.
Crashes on startup after the latest patch. Devs abandoned it.
Refunded. Career mode is a grind designed to push you to the shop.
